task.title: Unify the admin shell and report only actual activity
task.input: Existing AdminShell/page gates, M1 visual tokens, and M3-T15 activity API.
task.output: Unified admin shell, role-navigation visibility, AdminSessionActivity, and ordinary sign-out; personal-security forms are delivered separately by M3-T12.
task.accept: 1) Entry: after successful sign-in, use the existing shell on an admin page currently accessible to the role. Data source: GET /api/admin/account. Clicking admin-signout executes actual Auth.js signOut; a copied old cookie then gets 401 from GET account. Menu role data comes from the server. A 401 immediately clears this account's content and cancels in-flight requests (E-03, E-70). 2) POST /api/admin/account/session/activity follows only actual mouse/keyboard/route activity on a visible page, at most once per 15 minutes. Polling, hidden pages, and parameterless session reads send no activity. Blur/unmount remove listeners; assert actual expiry writes and racing revocation through the T15 endpoint (E-68). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
